messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary failure rate spike for sdk@v14 -> client negotiation errors (503/handshake) across eu-west-1 canary cluster. 90s rolling error rate 18% :rotating_light:

sara-oncall: seeing the same in datadog traces, paging tokens failing with decode errors. linking logs now.

marco-eng-sre: confirmed. stack shows `ClientHandshakeError: invalid_header_v2` during proto negotiation for ~14k requests/min. affects streaming/paging endpoints.

sara-oncall: impact? any customer-facing errors?

ellie-support: a couple of enterprise customers reporting increased 5xx on embed+stream routes, support tickets #4521 #4522. Notified account teams.

tanya-runtime: probable root: runtime kernel changed header encoding ordering in last deploy (canary). suspect compat bump in SDK v14 handshake binder.

marco-eng-sre: recommended immediate mitigation: flip feature-flag `canary_v14_negotiation` -> false (kill-switch) to force fallback to v13 negotiation shim.

sara-oncall: executing flag kill now via ops console. `/flags set canary_v14_negotiation false --scope canary-eu-west-1`

ops-bot: COMMAND OK: canary_v14_negotiation=false (applied to canary-eu-west-1). Propagating (10s).

marco-eng-sre: logs showing error rate dropping in first 30s. continuing monitoring.

kevin-pm: heads-up: ongoing customer incidents for customers on Dedicated? any data plane impact?

tanya-runtime: Dedicated unaffected; this is only canary cluster that got the new negotiation by rollout targeting canary-weight 10%. few hosted API customers on canary got errors.

ellie-support: current customer impact: ~8 customers experienced transient 5xx, customers with long-lived streaming sessions saw reconnects. No data loss reported.

sara-oncall: initiating rollback of canary rollout to v13 negotiation kernel for canary hosts. `deploy rollback --group canary-eu-west-1 --to-tag negotiation-v13-shim`

ops-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED: canary-eu-west-1 negotiation rollback. ETA ~2m per shard.

marco-eng-sre: adding temporary routing rule to divert new requests away from canary until rollback complete.

sara-oncall: rollback complete. metrics: canary error rate back to baseline within 90s.

kevin-pm: thanks. Customers in support threads pinged. we should prepare a short incident status for CSMs.

ellie-support: drafted message: "We observed a transient increase in errors for certain streaming requests while testing a new SDK negotiation path. We rolled back the canary and have mitigations in place. Reach out if you have ongoing issues." Want approval?

marco-eng-sre: approve. also create postmortem and label as release-rollback / sdk-compat. owner: marco.

sara-oncall: created incident ticket INF-2026, assigned marco, priority P2.

tanya-runtime: short-term action items: 1) revert feature flag default until compatibility tests added; 2) add gating check in CI for negotiation header ordering; 3) add canary telemetry for header mismatch counts.

marco-eng-sre: long-term: coordinate SDK v14 handshake spec with runtime teams; add golden-test harness that runs cross-version negotiation matrix.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: kill-switch applied, rollback complete, customer impact limited and transient.

sara-oncall: handing off to daytime pager @marco-eng-sre for follow-ups and postmortem. tagging for owners. :white_check_mark:

marco-eng-sre: taking ownership. I'll post a postmortem draft in #postmortems within 24h and list remediation steps.

kevin-pm: add a brief to product/marketing so CSMs can use consistent language.

ellie-support: I'll send the approved customer note and close the affected tickets after monitoring for 24h.

sara-oncall: closing Slack incident thread; will reopen if metrics degrade. Great triage everyone. :heart:
